_note: Pre-registered BEFORE any detector run (JCMM_1268 revision, 2026-10-21). Do not edit after results exist.
injection_source: src/preprocessing.py::inject_random_drift(seed=42, window_count=4, window_size=12); windows = Date.between(start, start+12) -> 13 inclusive days
input_data: data/processed/daily_demand.csv at commit f264989 (frozen; not regenerated)
unit_of_injection: (SKU, window) pair; expected 4 windows x 12 SKUs = 48 pairs
alert_definition: a DRIFT event in system_events.csv (pipeline.py logs one per SKU-day while the consecutive-flag count >= delta)
grace_rationale: equal to the rolling window w=7: injected errors remain in the rolling MAE for up to w-1 days after the window ends
true_positive: injected pair with >= 1 DRIFT alert for that SKU dated in [window_start, window_end + 7 days]
false_negative: injected pair with no DRIFT alert for that SKU in that interval
false_alarm_alert_day: DRIFT alert for SKU s on a date outside every grace-extended injected interval of s
false_alarm_episode: maximal run of consecutive-date false-alarm alert-days for one SKU
detection_delay_days: first DRIFT alert date in the interval minus window_start (TP pairs only)
reported_metrics: alert-day precision = in-interval alert-days / all alert-days
not_reported: true negatives / specificity at SKU-day level are not defined for an alarm stream and are not reported
